title_zh: 约定先测试仓库无线电再申请升级

scenario.label_zh: 约定先测试仓库无线电再申请升级
scenario.goal_zh: 描述仓库无线电传输不清的位置并约定先留测试记录再请求升级

context_zh: 虚构仓库工作沟通。两名员工讨论手持无线电通话质量，不进行任何实际系统配置。
author: author-phase12-c

sentences.speaker: Lewis
sentences.text: Can we upgrade the radios in the warehouse? I lose half your words near the back shelves.

sentences.speaker: Priya
sentences.text: Is the transmission bad everywhere back there, or only in one aisle?

sentences.speaker: Lewis
sentences.text: I've noticed it near aisle seven, but I haven't checked the others.

sentences.speaker: Priya
sentences.text: Let's test the usual positions and write down where the sound breaks up.

sentences.speaker: Lewis
sentences.text: Then we'll have something specific to include in the request.

sentences.speaker: Priya
sentences.text: Exactly. I'll meet you after the current delivery is finished, and we can do the checks together.
